title: A brand-new template only offers to choose a starting point
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  • You are on a desktop, creating a brand-new template.
custom_steps:
1. On the new template, confirm only the choice of starting point is shown: start from a template, or build from scratch — no section heading, field count, section menu, signature option or add-section control.
2. Choose either option and confirm the full builder then appears.
3. Confirm 'Require technician signature' is available while building and withheld only on that first empty screen.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A brand-new template shows only the choice of starting point (start from a template, or build from scratch), with no section heading, field count, section menu, signature option or add-section control.
  • As soon as the author chooses either option, the full builder appears.
  • The "Require technician signature" option is available while building and withheld only on that first empty screen.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9110 (S12 — Template builder authoring); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S12; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R1: “A brand-new template will show only the choice of starting point: start from a template, or build from scratch. No section heading, field count, section menu, signature option or add-section control”
  • S12-R2: “As soon as the author chooses either option, the full builder will appear”
  • S12-R3: “The "Require technician signature" option will be available while building, and withheld only on that first empty screen”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
